## About
Haven Collision Center is a body shop on Laventure Drive in Chamblee. We handle collision repair, refinishing, paintless dent repair, windshields and ADAS calibrations, and we work with your insurance company so you don't have to sort it all out alone.
We believe trust is the core of doing business. Our repairs are backed by a written lifetime limited warranty, and when the work is done, we detail your whole car inside and out, not just the area we fixed.
Neighbors have given us a 5 star rating across 227 Google reviews. Call us, send a photo, or stop by the shop and we'll walk you through every step.

## Services
- Insurance assistance and free estimates: Our claims managers work directly with your insurance company to keep the estimate simple. Send a photo, email, text, or visit the shop.
- Towing and concierge service: We offer concierge service within a 5 mile radius and towing service outside that radius, so the accident doesn't eat up your schedule.
- Collision repair: Careful repair work after an accident, done by our trained structural technicians.
- ADAS, calibrations and electrical diagnostics: Diagnostic scans and full calibrations using OEM software, procedures and tooling so your driver-assist systems work as they should.
- Windshields: A damaged windshield can affect visibility and some driver-assist systems. We restore it to manufacturer standards.
- Paintless dent repair: For dents from accidents or hail, we remove the damage while keeping your original paint finish when PDR can be used.
- Refinishing: Our trained refinish specialists use current tools and paint line to match your car's factory color.
- Detailing: After repairs, we clean and shine your whole vehicle inside and out, not just the area we worked on.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Our claims managers have a streamlined process for working with most major insurance carriers, and we help simplify the estimate for you and your insurer.

Q: How do I get an estimate?
A: Whatever is easiest for you. Upload a photo, email, text, or come by the shop on Laventure Drive.

Q: Can I come by on a Saturday?
A: Yes, from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. We're closed Sunday.
